Nobody told me the first 1,000 followers would be the hardest part of the job.

I posted every day for 4 months before anyone I didn't know left a comment.

The post that finally worked was about a spreadsheet. Not a story, not a lesson. A screenshot of a spreadsheet with 37 rows of rejected pitches and what each one cost me.

People don't want your wisdom. They want your receipts.

I still keep that spreadsheet. It has 212 rows now.
